text: run_pipeline.py finish runs verify.sh whose test suites import pytest; the cron venv has no pytest and no pip, so every gate test suite fails and finish exits 1 even on a clean run. Workaround used 2026-11-21: run finish with PATH=/usr/bin first (system python has pytest); one suite (scripts/test_illustration_overlay.py, 4 tests) still fails there on a PIL/numpy version difference in the subject-map fixture — pre-existing, environment-dependent, unrelated to any article. It blocks a green finish exit but not publishing or gates.

evergreen+tinkering_tax 2026-11-21: reviewer HELD a readable draft 3x before acceptance — Flesch floor is enforced on the REWRITE, so a draft at Flesch 49 keeps failing even when the rewrite is clean(er); build the draft to pass check_accessibility.py first (mine went 49.2 FAIL -> 63.6 ok), and front-load the first-person cues and the At a glance under the lead, not at the foot.
